changes.text: In 2023, the Company agreed to sell its legacy appliance recycling businesses (the Recycling Subsidiaries), which are now discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On March 9, 2023, we entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement (the "Recycling Purchase Agreement") with VM7 Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("VM7"), under which it agreed to acquire all of the outstanding equity interests of the Recycling Subsidiaries.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company announced its intent to formally separate its Biotechnology segment (Alyea), which is presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Biotechnology segment is presented as discontinued operations for the fiscal years ended December 27, 2025 and December 28, 2024.
